notes_for_editor: Forest name disagrees: Salmon National Forest (register, Forest Lookouts) vs Salmon-Challis National Forest (Idaho Fire Lookouts); not resolved. The 1975 removal year rests on one terse line on Forest Lookouts; the 1934 and 1944 staffing items are newspaper quotes as reproduced on that page, not the originals. The access label on Idaho Fire Lookouts is not interpreted and access is left out of facts. No source read describes the summit today. The Forest Lookouts page includes a July 2019 photo credit (Tom Lopez) for an image whose subject is not stated; not added to photos. The marker description quoted on Forest Lookouts is dated 1912 on that page, which would put a lookout house on the summit 17 years before the 1929 build date; not resolved.
